decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed house, by reason of its size, bulk and position, would fail to be secondary to the scale of the original house and would significantly interrupt the spacing between the end-of-terraced house and the corner of the street. Given that this is an important characteristic feature of Ash Grove repeated throughout, it is considered that the proposal would harm the original pattern of development in the area and would represent an overly obtrusive development on a highly visible corner plot. The proposal would therefore result in harm to the street scene and would represent an unacceptable form of infill development, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), H.1.1 (Location of New Housing Development), H.6.3 (Backland / Infill development) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a semi-detached two bedroom house, a single storey rear extension to existing house and detached single storey garage to rear with associated parking.
